name: China
overview: Scripture acknowledges the distant lands from which God's people will come, including the land of Sinim, often associated with China, highlighting God's sovereign plan for gathering nations (Isaiah 49:12). The gospel is promised to be preached throughout all nations, encompassing even the remotest regions, as a witness before the end of the age (Matthew 24:14). The unfolding of end-time events involves the preparation of the way for eastern kings (Revelation 16:12), suggesting a significant role for eastern peoples in God's prophetic timeline. Meanwhile, the resistance of the nations against God’s purposes is anticipated, as the heathen tumultuously assemble in opposition (Psalms 2:1).
